capability.description: Fetches PoetryDB author results using the required first CLI argument as the URL path value. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Poetry reference retrieval; not literary criticism, author biography, or title search.

constraint.io_signature: Input: author at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and PoetryDB result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one author path value accepted by PoetryDB
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: title is not an accepted input and no second argument is read
wrapper does not URL-encode, parse, locally truncate, or paginate the result
no authentication, cache, retry, or guarantee that the author exists

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing PoetryDB author results, URL, and HTTP status.

negative_intents: write literary criticism or identify plagiarism
